## v0.6.0 — BLE Companion, Web & SSH commanders

Major release. Cardputer stays a thin UI; the Android Companion owns networking and secrets over BLE.

**Apps:** Torch → Timer → Stopwatch → Web → SSH → Settings

---

### Companion (Android)

- Watch-style **Link** (Companion Device Manager) + lock-screen BLE standby
- **Battery saver** toggle for idle scan / wake-lock policy
- **HTTP presets** — name, URL, method, headers, body (phone storage)
- **SSH presets** — name, host, port, user, command; password in EncryptedSharedPreferences
- Password SSH via **sshj**, TOFU host keys on the phone
- **Test run** on HTTP/SSH presets (body + step log, Copy log) before flashing Cardputer
- Android BouncyCastle replaced so Curve25519 / X25519 KEX works
- Companion build: `0.6.2-m3` (or later)

### BLE link

- Protocol: Hello / Ping, HTTP `0x10`–`0x16`, SSH `0x20`–`0x26` ([docs/ble_link.md](docs/ble_link.md))
- On-demand connect from Web/SSH; idle disconnect; secrets never stored on device NVS

### Web app (M2)

- Cache-first site list + **Refresh sites...**
- Run preset → HTTP status footer + body paging (≤512 B)

### SSH app (M3)

- Cache-first host list + **Refresh hosts...**
- Run preset → exit status footer + combined stdout/stderr paging (≤512 B)
- Password auth only (keys / PTY / SFTP out of scope)

### Verify

- [docs/m2_verify.md](docs/m2_verify.md) · [docs/m3_verify.md](docs/m3_verify.md)

### Upgrade from v0.3.1

| Data | Notes |
|------|--------|
| Timer / Stopwatch / Settings | Kept |
| BLE pairing | Re-pair / Link Companion if needed |
| HTTP / SSH presets | Phone only (new) |

Install / flash the standalone firmware (or `dist/` M5Launcher build from the GitHub Release assets:
`cardputer_adv_firmware-<ver>.bin`).
Android: install **`CardputerCompanion-<ver>.apk`** from the same Release (sideload; debug-signed until a store keystore is added).

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.6.0`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.3.1...v0.6.0
